idea-plugin.name: Progress Touch Bar
idea-plugin.description:
Your progress bar theme, now on your macOS Touch Bar.

This plugin puts the IDE's background work on your Mac's Touch Bar: indexing, Gradle syncs, builds, anything that shows progress in the status bar. Never look for the tiny bar in the corner of the IDE again!

Why you'll love it

  • See progress at a glance. A full-height, animated bar shows exactly how far along you are, with the task's name and an optional percentage.
  • Your theme, on your Touch Bar. Running Nyan Progress Bar or another progress bar theme? It's on your Touch Bar too, fully animated. No theme? You get the IDE's clean standard bar.
  • Never in your way. Quick tasks don't flash past: the bar appears only after half a second (you choose the delay), and your normal Touch Bar comes back the moment the task ends.
  • One tap to dismiss. Need your usual Touch Bar buttons mid-task? Tap Hide and they're back.
  • Light on resources. It pauses when the IDE isn't in front, and you can set the frame rate to trade smoothness for battery.
  • Works out of the box. Once the Touch Bar is on (see below), there's nothing to configure. Fine-tune it in Settings | Tools | Progress Touch Bar.

Before you start

  • A Mac with a Touch Bar. On other systems the plugin stays quietly inactive.
  • JetBrains IDEs switched the Touch Bar off by default in 2025.1. Turn it on: Help | Find Action | Registry, enable ide.mac.touchbar.enabled, then restart the IDE.
  • In System Settings | Keyboard | Keyboard Shortcuts | Function Keys, make sure the IDE isn't set to always show function keys.
